title: ADR-057: Product Architecture Ontology as a Document Lifecycle Graph Extension
summary: Accepted decision establishing the Product Architecture Ontology as a DLG extension with stable concepts, typed relationships, temporal assertions, and dependency-direction doctrine.
authority_scopes: Product Architecture Ontology integration with the DLG

triggers: the decision is superseded or contradicted
the accepted ontology identity or assertion model materially changes
the Product Lanes contract or canonical ontology diverges from the decision
freshness.reason: The accepted decision, contract, and ontology status were reviewed at the Phase 1 base.

read_when: making or reviewing a Product Architecture Ontology decision
classifying product programs, capabilities, clients, adapters, or source subsystems
interpreting product-architecture assertion or dependency-direction boundaries
must_not_prove: a current product-architecture relationship or posture assertion corpus
runtime implementation, current support posture, or release qualification
